title: are there any group projects or interest in a group project here?
author: jfpforever

comments.author: titanunveiled
comments.body: Not sure of the point of group ai projects.  Agents do everything and only need directions from one person

replies.author: jfpforever
replies.body: a good ai game requires iteration. a lot of it. it also lets you use more ai allowances in a shorter period. and even when solo deving i often get "writers block" for idea's. also people to test things.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
That’s because most people are building half assed garbage. To actually build a quality game you have to put thought into each aspect. You can just tell AI to summon 20 agents and make no mistakes.

Why wouldn’t you want someone working on other levels or aspects of your game? Obviously there’s plenty of simple indie games a solo dev can build.

But there is also a lot of opportunity collaborating with other humans and sharing ideas…

replies.author: jfpforever
replies.body: that last part is so important to for anything ai related. as we move forward and rely on ai more and more its important to find ways to still keep and utilize our humanity.

replies.author: VigilanceOne
replies.body: Right? I don't understand some of the posts on this sub reddit. Comments like "Using AI still requires years to make a game that actually has polish" or like this posts(Unless he's actually looking for people to collaborate and share ideas) They don't even realize they are completely contradicting what AI was suppose to be. A tool to help speed up the process of making software/games. Then why does it still require years? You realize they are not using AI to assist in making games they are completely using AI for making games.

replies.body:
how many successful games you shipped already?

most people here think that soon they will be able to solo release GTA 7 in 6 months?

comments.body: Yo estoy creando un juego de Naruto 4x al estilo Ninja Saga, pero con funcionamiento del rise of kingdoms en cuanto a conquistar aldeas y países. Algún interesado no dudes en contactarme

replies.author: jfpforever
replies.body: "I'm creating a Naruto 4X game in the style of Ninja Saga, but with Rise of Kingdoms–style mechanics for conquering villages and countries. If anyone's interested, don't hesitate to contact me." what the guy above me said.

comments.author: OldManUDC
comments.body: Yeah I'm interested too. What does the shape of the work look like? Like we get on a discord, brainstorm, vote on the idea, 'white board' the architecture and split it into verticals?  Is somebody 'in charge' or will there be a project manager role? Wire up a shared Claude or GPT chat to keep the spec in order? I would love to be a part of it but I'm just not too familiar with how collaboration works in a game. I worked professionally in distributed systems, so we weren't stepping on eachothers toes too much. We would need defined boundaries, management of the contracts between those boundaries, negotiation when that contract changes.

replies.author: jfpforever
replies.body: i think most of this is going to depend on the group.

replies.author: OldManUDC
replies.body: Well at some point you're going to have to put up something. Because me or any competent engineer is going to ask, what is this collective bringing to the table? Are you going to facilitate and orchestrate? Who is the center of gravity? Do you have a plan or are you asking just to ask?

comments.author: RamboJesus_
comments.body: I'm interested in just having fun and learning more so yeah that would be cool

comments.author: Dear_Band4410
comments.body:

If you are interested i wouldnt mind sharing my project with someone that can come up with ideas etc and actually talk to about what is actually a good idea and what is just dumb to add, not after a quick cash grab release either :)
